articles.summary: On November 24, 2026, the Board of Directors of the Farmers National Banc Corp. (NASDAQ: FMNB) declared a quarterly cash dividend of $0.18 per share. The common stock cash dividend will have a record date of December 11, 2026 and is payable to shareholders on December 31, 2026. ABOUT FARMERS NATIONAL BANC CORP. Founded in 1887, Farmers National Banc Corp. is a diversified financial services company headquartered in Canfield, Ohio, with $7.1 billion in banking assets. Farmers National Banc Corp.’s wholly owned subsidiaries are comprised of The Farmers National Bank of Canfield, a full-service national bank engaged in commercial and retail banking with 80 banking locations in Ohio and western Pennsylvania, and Farmers Trust Company, which operates trust offices and offers services in the same geographic markets. articles.summary: Farmers National Bank announces two internal executive leadership changes. Brian Jackson will transition to Chief Operating Officer. Michael Oberhaus will become Chief Administrative and Risk Officer. Brian Jackson - Chief Operating Officer Jackson, who currently serves as Chief Information Officer, has been with Farmers since 2009. He brings more than 30 years of information technology experience to this new role. Jackson has been an integral leader of company-wide operational enhancements throughout his tenure with Famers. He is a lifelong Youngstown resident with a degree in Computer Science from Youngstown State University. Oberhaus joined Farmers in 2015 through the acquisition of First National Bank of Orville. His background includes more than 25 years of banking and financial industry experience, and he has been a certified public accountant since 2012.
